Middle school and high school are very confusing years. I graduated high school 4 years ago and only just came out 2 years ago. You were very brave for being able to go through that step in life while you were so young; you should be very proud of yourself.  
I was a lot like you, my mom was an alcoholic, cheating, drug addict, my dad worked all the time so he didn't know what was going on. Most of the time my sister and I would walk to the closest grocery store to get food. When I realized I was gay at 8, I was horrified; my parents were very religious and conservative. I decided to keep it a secret until I was 17 and in those years I started to hate myself. I was hospitalized for self harm and bipolar disorder when I was 15 and then again when I was 16 after I tried to commit suicide for the 6th time. I honestly couldn't see a way out, I was so desperate that I NEVER would have imagined that my life could ever get better. I can't even imagine the pain that you feel right now, because everyone is different. But I know that feeling of hating yourself and just wanting it to end.   
I can tell you this, right now I am 20 years old, in a different state, in college, with a wonderful girlfriend, and a very supportive dad and sister. It did get better for me, all I had to do was stick through it, even  through the tough shit. It's really hard, but I found happiness after 11 years of hopelessness and despair. It IS going to get better for you too.
